slices.focus: Nadia starts short-term counseling via employee assistance after 4 AM work-triaging disrupts her sleep.
slices.summary: After Omar points out Nadia is waking at 4 AM mentally triaging work cases, she takes an employee assistance referral and starts short-term counseling. Tools that help: writing case lists physically before bed, naming the 4 AM mental roll call, protecting two lunch walks per week, and using the phrase 'this is a queue, not a catastrophe.' She plans to continue counseling, lock lunch walks onto two fixed days, maintain the bedtime paper handoff, and track three weekly boxes (handoff consistency, walks taken, early wakeup frequency).
open_loops: Lock lunch walks onto two fixed days each week
Keep bedtime paper handoff even when it feels unnecessary
Track three simple weekly boxes: handoff most nights, two walks, early wakeups less frequent
Give Omar specific warning signs to flag (4 AM wakeups, case roll call, intensity before dinner)
decisions: Nadia started short-term counseling through an employee assistance referral after work stress began disrupting her sleep
